title: food containers
text:
food containers. UPDATE BELOW I had been looking for a good, quality set of reusable, washable, easy to stack/store set of food storage containers. Decided to try these. I purchased the small, medium (these) and large containers. One of the lids broke straight away and I thought... Hmm... maybe these were a mistake... but since that one lid, I've had NO issues. I've used them and washed them on the top rack in the dishwasher multiple times. They works fabulously. They stack/store efficiently. And I always have the size I need. Over all, less expensive than the other brand you buy in the store, and then fight stacking, storing and searching for lids. I continue using them and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE: 1/25/2019.... Sadly... another lid had split at the edge. :( When they are unbroken, they are fairly leak proof. But once the lid edge splits.. they are are not. To minimize splits...I find that gently pulling along the edges with your fingers works to a degree.
